meta.targetAudience: Louisiana workforce — personalized via 6-digit SOC (Standard Occupational Classification 2018) occupation codes
meta.intendedConsumer: Claude coding agent executing the plan phase-by-phase

stack.frontend: React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript 5.9 + Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui + Zustand (persist) + React Query + React Router v7
stack.hosting: Frontend on Vercel; backend currently local-only (deployment added in Phase 6)

principles: Content lives in TypeScript data files under frontend/src/data/ — never hardcode learning content inside components.
The Anthropic API key must never leave the FastAPI backend; all Claude traffic is proxied.
Every Louisiana-specific data point must be traceable to a cited source (BLS, O*NET, Eloundou et al., Anthropic Economic Index, LED, or PwC).
Per-SOC scores are published with an explicit confidence qualifier and must not be presented as precise.
Personalization is privacy-preserving and local-first by default (Zustand persist); server-side persistence requires opt-in auth introduced only in Phase 6.
WCAG 2.1 AA is a launch gate, not a polish task; accessibility checks apply per-phase.
tdd-guide writes tests before implementation; code-reviewer signs off before the next task starts.
Phases execute in order. Tasks inside a phase may parallelize if their dependency graph permits.
No file, import, link, or data reference may cross into or out of the LSU State-of-AI-Louisiana research project.

lsuProject.rule: This app does not import, link to, copy from, or write into /Users/artembaranovski/Downloads/LSU AI Research. The methodology Louisiana inherits (Eloundou exposure framework, 3-dimensional literacy model, RLMA geography) is sourced independently from public research.
lsuProject.enforcement: Any PR that introduces an LSU-project file path or URL fails code review.

separationOfConcerns.dataLineage: All per-SOC scores, skill bundles, and curriculum content are built from the primary sources listed under dataSources — not transcribed from the LSU draft.

criteria: High AI exposure (>30% per Eloundou et al. 2024 aggregated to SOC level)
High Louisiana employment (>5,000 workers per BLS OEWS 2025 LA data)
Megaproject-adjacent (Meta Hyperion, Amazon AWS, Hyundai Steel, Hut 8 / Jacobs, SSE Steel / Persona AI)
Strategic LA industries — energy & petrochemicals, manufacturing, healthcare, logistics & ports, agriculture, finance & insurance, education, public administration
socScope.expansionPath: Schema supports all ~800 detailed SOC codes; MVP only populates priority set. Non-priority SOCs fall back to sector-level content.

rlmaFramework.source: Louisiana Workforce Commission Regional Labor Market Areas (8 regions)

regions.name: New Orleans Region
regions.anchorProject: SSE Steel / Persona AI humanoid pilot (St. Bernard Parish)

priorityEmployers: SSE Steel Fabrication / Persona AI (St. Bernard)
Port of South Louisiana, Port of New Orleans

dataSources.name: Eloundou et al. (2024) — GPTs are GPTs: Labor Market Impact Potential of LLMs
dataSources.use: Task-level exposure scores aggregated to SOC-6-digit level for the exposure metric.
dataSources.licensing: Published in Science; task-level appendix data freely available.
dataSources.ingestion: One-time CSV ingest; versioned checksum stored with data.

dataSources.name: Anthropic Economic Index (2025)
dataSources.use: Augmentation vs automation split per occupation category. Calibrated nationally ~57% augmentation / 43% automation.
dataSources.ingestion: Programmatic fetch; adjust per-occupation split for augmentation and replacement metrics.

dataSources.name: O*NET 28.0 — Occupational Information Network
dataSources.use: SOC-coded tasks, skills, knowledge, abilities, technologies. Canonical occupation taxonomy.
dataSources.ingestion: Download tables (Occupation, Tasks, Skills, Technology Skills). Pin to a specific O*NET release version.

dataSources.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics — Louisiana 2025
dataSources.use: LA employment count per SOC, median wage, wage percentiles (10/25/50/75/90).
dataSources.licensing: Public domain (U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics).
dataSources.ingestion: Annual refresh script; archived snapshot per release.

dataSources.name: PwC AI Jobs Barometer 2024/2025
dataSources.use: Baseline wage premium for AI-skilled roles (56% national); per-SOC adjustment applied.
dataSources.licensing: Publicly reported aggregate statistics; cite at point of use.
dataSources.ingestion: Manual curation; premium per SOC is a derived estimate with confidence label.

dataSources.name: Long & Magerko (2020) — What is AI Literacy? Competencies and Design Considerations
dataSources.use: Three-dimensional literacy framework (Technical / Critical / Ethical) drives the skill-bundle structure for every SOC.
dataSources.licensing: Academic publication; cited at point of use.

dataSources.name: Louisiana Economic Development (opportunityLouisiana.gov)
dataSources.use: Megaproject metadata, employer announcements, parish-level investment data.
dataSources.licensing: Government press releases; cited by date.
dataSources.ingestion: Periodic manual curation; no live feed.

newDataSchemas.note: High-level shape; full TypeScript definitions are produced in Phase 1 Task P1-T1.

SOCOccupation.title: string
SOCOccupation.rlmaDistribution: record<RLMAId, number> (% of LA workers in each RLMA)

SOCScoreCard.invariant: augmentation + replacement ≈ exposure (deviation tolerated; noted to user)

SkillBundle.technical: SkillItem[] — prompting, tool use, hallucination recognition, context windows, domain-specific AI tools
SkillBundle.critical: SkillItem[] — output evaluation, uncertainty tolerance, metacognition, verification workflows
SkillBundle.ethical: SkillItem[] — bias recognition, data governance, accountability, privacy, academic/professional integrity
SkillBundle.domainSpecific: SkillItem[] — occupation-specific AI applications (e.g. predictive-maintenance for process operators)

phases.name: Blocker Fixes
phases.goal: Make the existing Lab and Module flows actually work end-to-end before building new capability on top.
successCriteria: A user can open /lab, compose a prompt, and see a Claude response rendered in ResponseViewer.
All three backend & frontend call sites reference model id 'claude-sonnet-4-6'.
A smoke test covers the prompt submission → response-render path.

tasks.title: Replace stale model ID claude-sonnet-4-6-20250514 with claude-sonnet-4-6
tasks.description: Three call sites default to a dated identifier that does not resolve. Update defaults in the frontend API client, the backend Pydantic request model, and the service function. Keep the field overridable per-request.
acceptanceCriteria: All three files use 'claude-sonnet-4-6' as the default model string.
Unit test asserts default value.
A manual curl against /api/prompt returns a 200 with 'content' populated.

tasks.title: Wire ResponseViewer into the Lab page
tasks.description: The Lab.tsx layout never renders ResponseViewer, so Claude responses are discarded. Add the component to the right-hand column of the Lab grid, under PromptEditor, wired to lab.response / lab.isLoading / lab.error from usePromptLab.
acceptanceCriteria: ResponseViewer renders below PromptEditor on desktop, stacked on mobile.
Loading state shows skeleton; error state shows message; success state renders markdown + token badge + copy button.
E2E test: send prompt, response text visible within 30s.

tasks.title: Add smoke + integration tests for the Lab round-trip
tasks.description: Vitest for scoring logic, Playwright for the full round trip against a stubbed backend. Also add pytest coverage for the prompt router (happy path, validation error, rate-limit 429).
acceptanceCriteria: `pnpm test` green; `uv run pytest` green.
Coverage ≥ 70% for usePromptLab.ts and prompt.py.

tasks.title: Verify end-to-end Claude call from dev environment
tasks.description: Run both servers locally, submit the scripted smoke prompt, confirm usage data (input/output tokens) surfaces, confirm markdown renders.
acceptanceCriteria: Screenshot evidence of full round-trip attached to PR.
Claude response ≥ 100 tokens visible in UI.

phases.name: Data Foundation — SOC, Glossary, LA Geography
phases.goal: Introduce the SOC-aware data model and the backend data layer without yet surfacing it to the user.
successCriteria: TypeScript types for SOCOccupation, SOCScoreCard, SkillBundle, LearningPath, GlossaryTerm, UserProfile exist and compile.
Backend serves /occupation/:soc and /curriculum/:soc from a persisted data store.
Glossary content file has ≥40 entries.
Parish → RLMA mapping is complete for all 64 LA parishes.

tasks.title: Extend types.ts with SOC and personalization types
tasks.description: Add discriminated-union-safe readonly types per the newDataSchemas block in this plan. Keep existing Module/RoleConfig types untouched. Export helpers (e.g. `isPrioritySOC`).
acceptanceCriteria: All new types are readonly.
tsc passes with strict mode.
No breaking changes to existing type consumers.

tasks.title: Create glossary data model and seed ≥40 terms
tasks.description: frontend/src/data/glossary.ts exports `GLOSSARY_TERMS: readonly GlossaryTerm[]`. Seed with: AI-concepts (LLM, token, context window, prompt, hallucination, RLHF, fine-tuning, agent, MCP, XML tags, RAG, temperature, system prompt), tools (Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Copilot), frameworks (CO-STAR, RISEN), LA-workforce (SOC, NAICS, O*NET, RLMA, OEWS), methodology (exposure, augmentation, replacement, wage premium, confidence level).
acceptanceCriteria: ≥40 terms with short + long definitions.
Every term has at least one seeAlso citation to a primary source.
No broken slug cross-references.
Terms covering the four score-card metrics explicitly define them.

tasks.title: Louisiana geography: parish ↔ RLMA mapping
tasks.description: frontend/src/data/louisiana.ts exports PARISHES, RLMAS, SECTORS, EMPLOYERS. All 64 LA parishes mapped to one of 8 RLMAs per LWC definitions. Each parish carries population, median household income (public BLS/census source cited), and a list of major employers present.
acceptanceCriteria: All 64 parishes present and RLMA-tagged.
Unit test asserts every parish has an RLMA.
Employer list cross-references priorityEmployers from the plan.

tasks.title: Extend Zustand userStore with SOC/parish/sector profile
tasks.description: Add socCode, parish, rlma, sector, currentEmployer to UserState. Keep existing `role` for compatibility. Persist via zustand/middleware. Add selector hooks (useProfile, useSOC, useRLMA).
acceptanceCriteria: localStorage value `ai-literacy-user` migrates old records (role-only) to new shape without data loss.
Unit test covers migration.

tasks.title: Backend data layer — SQLite + ingest scripts
tasks.description: Introduce SQLite (or JSON files if simpler) under backend/data/. Tables: occupation, score_card, skill_bundle, learning_path, data_source, methodology_revision. Ingest scripts read from /research/eloundou/, /research/onet/, /research/bls-oews-la/ (gitignored raw data, checked-in checksums).
acceptanceCriteria: Ingest scripts idempotent; re-running does not duplicate.
Data source checksums checked in to repo so build is reproducible.
pytest covers the repository layer.

tasks.title: Backend endpoints — /occupation/:soc and /curriculum/:soc
tasks.description: Add FastAPI routes returning the full SOCOccupation and the derived LearningPath. Both routes cached (ETag + Cache-Control: public, max-age=3600) since data is ingest-time-bound. Add /occupations/search?q=... with fuzzy match on title and SOC.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI docs available at /docs.
All endpoints return 404 for unknown SOC with JSON error body.
Rate limits inherited from existing config.

tasks.title: Frontend API client — occupation + glossary fetchers
tasks.description: Extend lib/api.ts with fetchOccupation(soc), searchOccupations(query), fetchCurriculum(soc). Integrate with React Query (cache per SOC, staleTime 1h, retry once).
acceptanceCriteria: Typed fetchers matching backend response shape.
React Query devtools visible in dev mode only.

phases.name: SOC Content — Curated Priority Set
phases.goal: Populate per-SOC scores, skill bundles, and learning paths for 60–80 priority Louisiana occupations.
successCriteria: ≥60 SOCs fully populated end-to-end.
Every score carries a confidence qualifier + cited source.
Every skill bundle maps across all three literacy dimensions.
Every learning path resolves to at least 3 existing modules.

tasks.title: Curate the priority SOC list for LA
tasks.description: Produce docs/priority-socs.md (in-repo) listing 60–80 SOCs selected per the criteria in louisianaContext.socScope. For each: rationale, LA employment count, exposure prior, megaproject link. Reviewed by planner agent.
acceptanceCriteria: 60–80 SOCs listed.
Every priority criterion represented (exposure, employment, megaproject, strategic industry).
CSV seed file consumed by ingest pipeline in P2-T2.

tasks.title: Compute per-SOC score cards (exposure / augmentation / replacement / wage premium)
tasks.description: Implement backend/scripts/compute_score_cards.py. Exposure = mean of task-level Eloundou binary labels per SOC. Augmentation and replacement split per Anthropic Economic Index; if SOC not covered, fall back to sector-mean with confidence=low. Wage premium = PwC baseline × SOC-specific multiplier derived from LA OEWS 90th/50th percentile spread. Persist with source + confidence + lastComputed.
acceptanceCriteria: Invariant check: augmentation + replacement within ±15% of exposure (flagged otherwise).
Every score has non-null confidence.
Test fixtures cover three SOCs across three confidence levels.

tasks.title: Author per-SOC skill bundles (3-dim literacy + domain-specific)
tasks.description: For each priority SOC, populate technical/critical/ethical skills grounded in Long & Magerko (2020) plus a domainSpecific track derived from O*NET tasks where AI plausibly augments or replaces. Bundles stored in SQLite and surfaced via API.
acceptanceCriteria: Every SOC has ≥3 items per dimension.
Every domainSpecific skill cites a concrete O*NET task.
Validator script passes in CI.

tasks.title: Derive per-SOC learning paths
tasks.description: Algorithm: ordered module sequence based on skill-bundle coverage. Every existing module (ai-fundamentals, prompt-engineering, claude-workflows, responsible-ai, practical-workflows) tagged with which skill dimensions it addresses. Path = topological order covering the SOC's priority gaps, estimated duration < 6 hours.
acceptanceCriteria: Every priority SOC resolves to a path of 3–7 modules.
Estimated total minutes ≤ 360.
Paths cover all three literacy dimensions at least once.

tasks.title: Document SOC research methodology in DATA.md
tasks.description: DATA.md (in-repo, gitignored raw data stays out) documents: source list with versions, aggregation formulas, confidence rubric, known limitations, per-SOC revision log. Not the public methodology page — that is deferred to FUTURE_IDEAS.md. This is engineering docs.
acceptanceCriteria: Every dataSources entry has a matching section in DATA.md.
Confidence rubric is quantitative where possible.

phases.name: Occupation Picker + Progressive Profile
phases.goal: Give users a way to find their occupation and build a minimal profile that drives personalization.
successCriteria: A new user completes onboarding (role → occupation → parish) in under 90 seconds.
Occupation search returns relevant SOCs for common job-title queries.
Profile is persisted client-side and survives refresh.

tasks.title: Build /occupations page with search
tasks.description: Search by title keyword (e.g. 'welder', 'data analyst', 'nurse') and by SOC code. Debounced input, keyboard-navigable result list. Each result shows title, SOC, LA employment, top RLMAs, exposure-metric preview.
acceptanceCriteria: Search returns results in <200ms on warm cache.
a11y: results announced to screen readers; arrow-key navigation works.
Empty-state message guides to sector browsing.

tasks.title: Parish picker grouped by RLMA
tasks.description: Dropdown or dialog showing 8 RLMAs with their constituent parishes. Selecting a parish auto-fills RLMA. Mobile: bottom-sheet.
acceptanceCriteria: All 64 parishes selectable.
Selection persists via useProfile hook.

tasks.title: Sector + employer picker
tasks.description: Two linked selects; employer list filters by parish if selected. priorityEmployers from the plan are highlighted with a 'megaproject-adjacent' badge.
acceptanceCriteria: Selection optional at every step; user can skip.
Megaproject badges match louisianaContext.priorityEmployers.

tasks.title: Progressive profile onboarding flow
tasks.description: New route /onboarding: role → occupation → parish → sector → employer (optional). Every step skippable; profile is usable after role alone. Implemented as a single controlled wizard with per-step URL segment for browser back-button support.
acceptanceCriteria: Fresh user completes in <90s (manual QA).
Progress persists if they close the tab mid-flow.
Keyboard and screen-reader navigable.

tasks.title: Redesign Profile page as assembled context view
tasks.description: /profile shows: role, SOC card (w/ mini score preview), parish + RLMA, sector, employer if set, and progress stats. 'Edit' buttons deep-link back to onboarding steps.
acceptanceCriteria: All profile fields visible; empty fields show '+ Add' prompt.
Visual hierarchy: SOC card most prominent.

tasks.title: Diagnostic assessment → SOC suggestion
tasks.description: Short (6–10 question) multiple-choice assessment that asks about daily tasks, tools used, decision authority, and output type. Maps answers to SOC candidates via a weighted lookup table. Surfaces top 3 SOC suggestions with confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Assessment completes in <5 min.
Top suggestion confidence displayed.
User can override suggestion and pick SOC manually.

phases.name: Personalization Engine
phases.goal: Turn the assembled profile into an adaptive learning experience — score cards, compare views, occupation-aware module filtering, and inline glossary.
successCriteria: Score card visible on every occupation page and on the profile dashboard.
Two-SOC comparison functional and shareable via URL.
Modules reorder and filter based on the user's SOC.
Any glossary-covered term in module content is linkable to its term page.

tasks.title: Score card component — 4 metrics with confidence + provenance
tasks.description: Reusable component rendering exposure, augmentation, replacement, wage premium. Each metric: value, confidence badge, source footnote link. 'Learn how this is computed' link routes to /glossary#methodology (and eventually the deferred /methodology page).
acceptanceCriteria: Four metrics visible with clear legend.
Confidence visually distinct (color + text label).
Source footnotes are keyboard-focusable.
Component is role-agnostic — works in comparison and detail views.

tasks.title: Compare two SOCs view
tasks.description: /compare/:socA/:socB route. Side-by-side score cards + diff view highlighting deltas + career-ladder indicator (is B a plausible next step from A? based on relatedSOCs).
acceptanceCriteria: URL is shareable and reproduces the view.
Delta indicators render with appropriate semantics (exposure going up can mean either 'at risk' or 'opportunity' — label clarifies).
Mobile-friendly accordion layout.

tasks.title: Occupation-aware module filtering on /learn
tasks.description: When profile has a SOC, /learn reorders modules by the user's learningPath priority. Unrelated modules still visible under 'Browse all'. 'Recommended for your role' badge on prioritized modules.
acceptanceCriteria: Without profile: behaves as today.
With SOC: prioritized list renders first; 'why these?' link expands rationale.
Accessibility: prioritization does not hide content from keyboard navigation.

tasks.title: Personalized learning path view on occupation page
tasks.description: /occupations/:soc route shows: occupation header, score card, skill bundle tabs (Technical / Critical / Ethical / Domain), learning path with module links, and 'Compare with another SOC' CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: All sections render with data from /occupation/:soc and /curriculum/:soc.
Learning-path items deep-link into existing module routes.
Empty-state copy when SOC lacks data.

tasks.title: Career-ladder visualization
tasks.description: On occupation detail, show relatedSOCs as a small graph or list with score-card deltas. Click to compare. Highlights upward-mobility paths where replacement risk drops or wage premium rises.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders at least 3 related SOCs when data permits.
Accessible: not solely color-coded.

tasks.title: Inline glossary tooltip in module content
tasks.description: ContentRenderer recognizes [[term:slug]] markup in paragraph/list/callout blocks and renders an accessible popover with the short definition + link to /glossary#slug.
acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard users can open/close tooltip with space + escape.
Screen readers announce 'term: {term}, definition: {short}'.
Bad slug references logged in dev console but do not break render.

tasks.title: Full glossary page at /glossary
tasks.description: A-Z index, category filters (ai-concepts, la-workforce, methodology, tools), search, deep-link anchors per term. Each entry: term, short, long, related, see-also links.
acceptanceCriteria: All ≥40 terms render.
URL hashes are stable and shareable.
Category filter preserves scroll position.

phases.name: Louisiana Integrations
phases.goal: Connect the curriculum to real Louisiana megaprojects, parishes, and wage data.
successCriteria: Users in occupations adjacent to a megaproject see that project as a pathway.
Parish selection surfaces local employer options.
Wage premium is presented in LA dollars, not just as a %.

tasks.title: Megaproject data + directory page
tasks.description: frontend/src/data/megaprojects.ts with canonical entries (Meta Hyperion, Amazon AWS, Hyundai Steel, Hut 8, SSE/Persona AI). /megaprojects page lists them with parish, investment, workforce size, relevant SOCs, typical roles, and a 'prepare for this employer' CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: Every megaproject entry cites LED announcement date.
CTA links into occupation detail for the most relevant SOC.
No speculative project details; investment numbers match verified LED announcements.

tasks.title: Parish-aware content surfacing
tasks.description: Occupation detail and module pages optionally surface a 'In {parish}/{RLMA}' section showing relevant local employers, megaprojects, training providers.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders only when profile has parish/RLMA set.
Gracefully degrades if no local data for that parish.
No reliance on LSU-project data.

tasks.title: Wage premium surfacing — percent + dollars
tasks.description: Score card shows 'AI-skilled version of this role earns ~X% more' AND an absolute LA dollar estimate derived from the occupation's OEWS median wage. Tooltip explains derivation.
acceptanceCriteria: Dollar figure cites BLS OEWS LA year.
Shows 'low-confidence estimate' label where applicable.
Unit test covers wage-premium math.

tasks.title: Star Jobs integration — stub interface
tasks.description: Abstract client for the LED Star Jobs portal: given a SOC + parish, return open postings. Ship with a stub (mock data) and environment flag for future real integration. UI surface: 'See open Louisiana jobs for this role'.
acceptanceCriteria: Client interface mockable via env var STARJOBS_STUB=true.
README documents switch-over process for real integration.
Stub returns realistic sample postings.

tasks.title: Employer partnership data layer
tasks.description: Schema for employer-specific curriculum tracks (e.g. 'Amazon AWS Data Center Ops'). Not surfaced to end users yet; scaffolds the post-launch cohort feature from FUTURE_IDEAS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema supports N-to-M employer ↔ SOC ↔ module_override relationship.
No UI surface yet; tested via API only.

phases.name: Polish, Launch, Credentialing, Integrations
phases.goal: Ship v1. Accessibility, internationalization, offline, analytics, certificates, MCP surface, backend deploy.
successCriteria: WCAG 2.1 AA audit passes.
EN + ES + FR baseline strings complete.
PWA installable; core content available offline.
Backend deployed to Fly.io (or chosen alternative).
MCP server exposes SOC+curriculum data to external clients.

tasks.title: WCAG 2.1 AA audit & remediation
tasks.description: Run axe + manual keyboard + screen-reader audits across all pages. Fix focus management, color contrast, form labels, ARIA roles. Document known exceptions.
acceptanceCriteria: axe CLI reports 0 violations at AA.

Docs list any contextual exceptions with rationale.

tasks.title: Internationalization — EN / ES / Louisiana-French
tasks.description: Introduce react-i18next (or equivalent). Extract all user-facing strings from components. Provide EN baseline, ES translation, FR-LA translation. Content data files (modules, glossary) remain EN for v1; path to localized content captured in FUTURE_IDEAS.md.
acceptanceCriteria: Every page renders in all three locales.
Language preference persists in userStore.
Unit test asserts no hardcoded user-facing strings remain.

tasks.title: Offline-first PWA
tasks.description: Service worker caching: Vite PWA plugin. Module content + glossary available offline. Lab feature clearly marked as online-only.
acceptanceCriteria: App installable from Chrome/Safari.
Lighthouse PWA score ≥90.
Offline test: disable network, /learn still renders.

tasks.title: Opt-in learning analytics
tasks.description: Optional anonymous event stream (module started, section completed, quiz answered, assessment result, SOC selected). Clear consent modal; data stays on our backend (no third-party). Powers future internal research without requiring personal identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: Opt-in default OFF.
No PII collected; session id is rotating anonymous UUID.
Consent revocable and honored immediately.
Security review signed off.

tasks.title: Certificate / badge system
tasks.description: On completing a full learning path for a SOC, user earns a named badge. Stored client-side by default; server-side if auth is enabled (no auth introduced yet in v1).
acceptanceCriteria: Badge visible on profile.
Badge JSON export available (Open Badges 3.0-shaped stub).

tasks.title: Credential export — LinkedIn / résumé artifact
tasks.description: User can generate a PDF/Markdown summary of their completed tracks with verifiable-credentials-shaped metadata. Signed hash for basic tamper-resistance.
acceptanceCriteria: PDF downloads successfully.
Markdown version renders on GitHub.
Signed hash verifiable via /credentials/verify/:hash.

tasks.title: MCP server for external tool integration
tasks.description: New Python package under /mcp-server/ exposing tools: get_occupation(soc), search_occupations(query), get_curriculum(soc), get_glossary_term(slug), compare_socs(a, b). Wraps the existing backend repository layer. Streamable HTTP transport; stdio also supported for local use.
acceptanceCriteria: Server registers successfully with Claude Desktop / Claude Code.
All five tools documented with input/output schemas.
Tests cover at least 2 tools end-to-end against a local backend.

tasks.title: Security review of end-to-end surface

acceptanceCriteria: No HIGH or CRITICAL findings open.

OWASP Top 10 checklist attached.

Secrets set via platform secret manager, not checked in.
Frontend Vercel deploy points to prod backend.

tasks.title: Full E2E test suite
tasks.description: Playwright journeys: onboarding, occupation search, profile completion, module completion, Lab prompt round-trip, compare-SOCs, glossary lookup, badge earn.
acceptanceCriteria: ≥8 critical-path journeys green in CI.
Traces + videos uploaded on failure.
Flaky tests quarantined, not deleted.

tasks.title: Document release — v1.0
tasks.description: CHANGELOG, README updates, short public explainer (non-policy) about what the app does, how to self-host, and how to contribute.
acceptanceCriteria: README quickstart works from clean clone.
CHANGELOG reflects all phases.

crossCuttingConcerns.name: Data freshness policy
crossCuttingConcerns.description: BLS OEWS LA is annual; O*NET is rolling; Eloundou is static. Document per-dataset refresh expectations; surface 'data as of' timestamps in the UI.

crossCuttingConcerns.name: Confidence transparency
crossCuttingConcerns.description: Every computed number in the UI carries a confidence label and a source link. No unqualified statistics.

crossCuttingConcerns.name: Content governance
crossCuttingConcerns.description: Skill-bundle changes require content-research-writer review + at least one peer sign-off. Keep a per-SOC revision log.

crossCuttingConcerns.name: Privacy & local-first default
crossCuttingConcerns.description: No account required. Profile and progress persist in localStorage only unless user opts in to server-side sync in a future phase.

crossCuttingConcerns.name: Louisiana scope lock
crossCuttingConcerns.description: The app's content and data are Louisiana-first. National defaults exist (e.g. PwC wage premium baseline) but are explicitly labeled as national priors when surfaced.

crossCuttingConcerns.name: Agent / skill usage hygiene
crossCuttingConcerns.description: Claude coding agent MUST invoke planner for any task above M effort before coding; MUST invoke tdd-guide for test-first on every implementation task; MUST invoke code-reviewer before marking any task complete.

agentsReference.planner: Used at start of any L or XL task to produce an implementation plan.
agentsReference.architect: System design / data modeling tasks (e.g. P1-T1, P2-T4, P3-T6, P5-T4, P6-T6, P6-T7).
agentsReference.tdd-guide: Test-first workflow enforcement on every implementation task.
agentsReference.code-reviewer: MUST run before any task is marked complete.
agentsReference.security-reviewer: Mandatory for analytics, credentials, and full surface review (P6-T4, P6-T8).
agentsReference.database-reviewer: Backend data layer tasks (P1-T5, P2-T2, P5-T5).
agentsReference.content-research-writer: Glossary, skill bundles, methodology docs, megaproject directory.
agentsReference.refactor-cleaner: Called as-needed when tasks introduce duplication.

skillsReference.claude-api: Any change to model ID, SDK usage, prompt-caching adoption.
skillsReference.mcp-server-patterns: Tool/resource definitions for the MCP server.
skillsReference.backend-patterns: FastAPI structure, repository pattern, API design.
skillsReference.tdd-workflow: Test-first for every task with code changes.
skillsReference.python-patterns: Backend idioms, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy or plain SQLite.
skillsReference.e2e: Runs the Playwright suite and uploads artifacts.
skillsReference.interface-design: UX of SOC picker, score card, compare view, glossary.
skillsReference.design-consultation: First-time visual decisions for the score card and compare view.

Invoke tdd-guide to author tests before implementation.
Implement the minimum change to pass tests.
Invoke code-reviewer. Address CRITICAL + HIGH findings.
Mark the task complete only when all acceptanceCriteria are demonstrably met.
If a task reveals a missing dependency, add it explicitly to the plan's change log rather than silently expanding scope.
